Lemma
[The orthonormal frame-bundle frame] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0452, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0453 ↗ def:chow-ii-horizontal-frame-fields ↗ def:chow-ii-rotation-fields 1. appf:F.23,appf:F.24,appf:F.25\group Orthonormal Frame Bundle

The fields $ ho _{ab}$ are tangent to $\mathcal O\mathcal M$ and act on a 1-form by $ ho _{ab}(V_c)=g_{ac}V_b-g_{bc}V_a$. The fields $\{ abla _a\} $ and $\{ ho _{bc}\} _{b<c}$ form an orthogonal basis on $\mathcal O\mathcal M$, with $| abla _a|=1$ and $| ho _{bc}|=\sqrt2$. Moreover, \[ [ abla _a, abla _b]= frac 12R_{abcd}g^{ce} ho _{de}, \qquad [ ho _{ab}, abla _c]=g_{ac} abla _b-g_{bc} abla _a, \] and \[ [ ho _{ab}, ho _{cd}]=g_{ac} ho _{bd}+g_{bd} ho _{ac} -g_{ad} ho _{bc}-g_{bc} ho _{ad}. \]
